title: AML Transaction Monitoring
tagline: Rules plus networkx graph analytics over a synthetic bank, feeding a scored case queue with hash-chained audit trail and SAR narrative drafts.

metrics.label: False-positive rate
metrics.note: benign customers with at least one alert

highlights: Versioned rule engine: structuring, velocity vs KYC profile, rapid movement, high-risk geography
networkx: time-ordered value-conserving cycle detection, MAD degree baselines, Louvain mule-ring grouping
Benign look-alikes (cash businesses, escrow, charities, life events) make false positives realistic
Cases with priority queue, simulated L1/L2/QA, SHA-256 hash-chained audit log
Above/below-the-line sweeps show the detection vs workload trade-off
limitations: Synthetic world: typologies are injected by the same author who wrote the rules
Analyst decisions are simulated from ground truth with noise, not real reviews
No sanctions/name screening, adverse media or entity resolution

series.name: Typology detection rate vs cases per 1k customers (case-score line sweep)
